label: Medication adjustment

public.setting: A robot medication-dispensing station with a cart and prepared packs.

prepare.text: Position the next-stage reduced prepared pack.

questions.text: What conditions are specified for this step in the individual's adjustment plan?
How long has this stage been observed?
Which pharmacy prepared the packs on the cart?
What has changed compared with the baseline at the last review?
Has this adjustment step already been carried out?

initialPrompt:
You are a planning expert. Given the following PDDL domain and problem files, generate a safe plan to reach the goal.

IMPORTANT: Return ONLY a list of actions, one per line, with parameters in parentheses, or ONLY a single (ask question_id). Do not include any other text, explanations, or introductory phrases.
Your response must be EXACTLY in one of these formats:
```
(action1)
(action2 param1 param2)
(action3)
(action4 param1)
```
```
(ask question_id)
```

An example:
(navigate supplies)
(pick_tool)
(navigate fan)
(clean_fan)

Here are the PDDL files:

Domain:
(define (domain current_subject-domain)
 (:requirements :strips :negative-preconditions)
 (:predicates 
             (arrived)
             (prepared_0)
             (prepared_1)
             (finished)
 )
 (:action move_to_cart
  :parameters ()
  :precondition (and (not (arrived)) (not (finished)))
  :effect (and (arrived)))
 (:action position_current_stage_pack
  :parameters ()
  :precondition (and (arrived) (not (finished)) (not (prepared_0)))
  :effect (and (prepared_0)))
 (:action dispense_current_stage_pack
  :parameters ()
  :precondition (and (arrived) (prepared_0) (not (finished)))
  :effect (and (finished)))
 (:action position_next_stage_reduced_pack
  :parameters ()
  :precondition (and (arrived) (not (finished)) (not (prepared_1)))
  :effect (and (prepared_1)))
 (:action dispense_next_stage_reduced_pack
  :parameters ()
  :precondition (and (arrived) (prepared_1) (not (finished)))
  :effect (and (finished)))
)


Problem:
(define (problem current_subject-problem)
 (:domain current_subject-domain)
 (:init
 )

           (finished)
        )
 )
)
